title: QED
label: QED
description:
A free-to-run Discord bot for mathematics, built with Python, discord.py and SymPy.

- Symbolic calculator: simplify, factor, expand, differentiate, integrate, limits, equation solving and matrix operations, with results typeset as LaTeX images. When a result can't be established, it says so rather than guessing.
- Problem of the Day: a daily university-level problem with private hints, symbolic answer checking, streaks and a leaderboard, drawn from a 42-problem bank whose answers are each independently verified by tests.
- Safe by design: user input is never eval'd. It's validated against an AST whitelist and run in a sandboxed worker process with timeout and memory limits.
- Reliable scheduling: state lives in SQLite, so restarts, outages and daylight-saving changes never cause duplicate or missed posts.

title: Discrete Fourier Transform Sketcher
label: DFT Sketcher
description:
• Used HTML5's canvas API for the animation, allowing each frame to be drawn manually.
• Completed independent research on the discrete Fourier transform and implemented it using
  vanilla JavaScript Math libraries.
• Used DOMParser and SVG DOM APIs to sample SVG paths accurately, and FileReader to enable
  native file imports.
